Careers

Join our team of skilled professionals and make a difference by protecting critical infrastructure around the world with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions

Request A Demo

Contact us today to discuss how we can help you meet your cyber security requirements

Join our international team

We believe in the power of community and collaboration. Our thriving community is built on friendship, teamwork, and mutual appreciation. Explore our career opportunities and apply today.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and gain expertise in critical infrastructure cybersecurity
  • Collaborate with an international team of skilled professionals in a dynamic and supportive work environment

  • Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with flexible schedules and other benefits that promote employee well-being

WE FOCUS ON OUR CLIENTS

We focus on our clients at CybergymIEC to provide customized solutions and services tailored to their specific needs. This approach builds trust, ensures satisfaction, and achieves long-term success.

WE HONOUR OUR HISTORY

At CybergymIEC, we honor our history as a pioneer in critical infrastructure cybersecurity. Initially established to help defend the Israel Electric Corporation, our legacy inspires us to continue developing cutting-edge solutions and services that protect critical infrastructure around the world

WE VALUE OUR PEOPLE

At CybergymIEC, we value our people as the foundation of our success. We invest in their growth and development, and provide a supportive work environment that fosters collaboration and innovation.

WE REWARD SUCCESS

At CybergymIEC, we reward success to recognize and motivate the hard work and dedication of our employees. Our culture of appreciation and recognition helps drive innovation and fosters a positive work environment.
